b2-24-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Be Quiet?
b2-24-01.scenario: On the Kis-Balaton, Matula bácsi asks you why the first rule in the reeds is silence.
b2-24-01.prompt: Tell Matula bácsi the purpose of the rule.
cues: Give the purpose of the rule
b2-24-01.target: A vadak megóvása érdekében a csend az első szabály.
b2-24-01.english: In the interest of protecting the wild animals, silence is the first rule.
b2-24-01.canDo: I can say what an action is for using végett, érdekében and céljából

b2-24-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Fields and Water
b2-24-02.scenario: Matula bácsi tells Tutajos that river regulation gave farmers more land. He asks you what is needed now.
b2-24-02.prompt: Tell Matula bácsi what river regulation caused and what must happen now.
cues: Say what must be done with the water
b2-24-02.target: A folyamszabályozás folytán sok föld lett, de most vissza kell engedni a vizet.
b2-24-02.english: Owing to river regulation there is a lot of land, but now the water has to be let back.
b2-24-02.canDo: I can trace environmental cause-and-effect chains using következtében and hatására

b2-24-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Balance
b2-24-03.scenario: Tutajos asks you whether dams and canals always mean progress. Matula bácsi listens.
b2-24-03.prompt: Answer Tutajos: say what must be balanced and why.
cues: Name the two sides to balance
Give the purpose of the balance
b2-24-03.target: A vizes élőhelyek megőrzése céljából egyensúlyt kell teremteni a gazdaság és az ökoszisztéma között.
b2-24-03.english: In order to preserve wetland habitats, a balance has to be created between the economy and the ecosystem.
b2-24-03.canDo: I can name habitats, ecosystems and water-management ideas and say why they are protected

b2-24-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Over the Limit
b2-24-04.scenario: A factory near the Kis-Balaton has gone over its limit. Tutajos asks you what the authority did.
b2-24-04.prompt: Tell Tutajos what the authority did and why.
b2-24-04.target: A határérték túllépése következtében a hatóság felfüggesztette a gyár engedélyét.
b2-24-04.english: As a consequence of exceeding the limit, the authority suspended the factory's licence.
b2-24-04.canDo: I can report what an impact assessment found about limits and emissions

b2-24-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Motorway
b2-24-05.scenario: At a public hearing about a new motorway near the Kis-Balaton, Tutajos asks you what you propose.
b2-24-05.prompt: Tell Tutajos what you propose and for what purpose.
cues: Give the purpose of the change
b2-24-05.target: A tájrombolás elkerülése végett módosítani kell az autópálya nyomvonalát.
b2-24-05.english: In order to avoid landscape destruction, the route of the motorway must be modified.
b2-24-05.canDo: I can give reasons for and against a big project using céljából, végett and érdekében

b2-24-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Let the Water Back
b2-24-consolidation.scenario: Matula bácsi tells you that the big dams are being opened again. He asks you why.
b2-24-consolidation.prompt: Tell Matula bácsi why the water must be let back.
cues: Say what must happen to the water
b2-24-consolidation.target: A vizes élőhelyek megóvása érdekében vissza kell engedni a vizet.
b2-24-consolidation.english: In the interest of protecting the wetlands, the water has to be let back.
b2-24-consolidation.canDo: I can use purpose phrases (végett, érdekében, céljából) after possessed nouns
